title: How It Works
description: We keep it personal and flexible. Every menu is designed around your gathering — reach out, tell us about your event, and we'll handle the rest.

steps.title: Reach Out
steps.description: Contact us via WhatsApp to discuss your event, guest count, and any preferences. We accommodate gatherings from as few as 5 guests.

steps.title: Customise Your Menu
steps.description: Choose from our curated catering packages or request a tailored menu. We scale portions and options to fit your event perfectly.

steps.title: Enjoy the Experience
steps.description: Sit back while we bring refined, home-crafted food directly to your gathering — professionally prepared and beautifully presented.
